success: Separate stable prerequisite recall, application failure, supplied-premise rescue, generic reasoning-check rescue, and RL credit assignment using paired family-level analysis.
retention: 91 previously audited valid families, original and paraphrase, base/CPT/direct-SFT/CPT-SFT/GSPO; no-thinking concise system, greedy 192 tokens.
mechanisms: All 312 original questions. Two independently audited prerequisite facts with two equivalent wordings when compositional; primitive recall flagged separately. Matched merged RL reference and final RL. Original, relevant facts, irrelevant facts, and generic relation-check prompts. RL scaling 4 and 16 is a direction diagnostic, not a higher-learning-rate training result.
statistics: Question/family paired bootstrap 10000 replicates. Conditional denominators reported; repeated wordings are not independent observations.
safeguards: No checkpoint overwritten. No test-derived probes used for training.
Reference and premise audit frozen before target generation.
Answer-bearing facts are positive access controls, not proof of reasoning improvement.
One training seed; model judge is not clinical expert gold.
